top_findings.title: CSV loader splits on '","' but Kaggle CSVs are only partially quoted — 4/5 match files and ALL players dropped
top_findings.evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp_server.py:120,165,204,243,338 use line.split('","'). First data rows split into: Brasileirao=4 (<9), Brazilian_Cup=2 (<6), Libertadores=4 (<7), BR-Football=1 (<10), fifa_data=1 (<15) — all hit the len() guard and continue. Only novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv (split(',') at :281 -> 13 parts) loads. Runtime log (_judge/attempt-001.stdout.log): 'Loaded 6886 matches and 0 players'.
top_findings.suggestion: Use the csv module (csv.reader/DictReader) instead of splitting on a literal delimiter; the files are partially quoted with embedded commas.

top_findings.title: Competition filter exists but only one competition's data loads
top_findings.evidence: find_matches_by_team/find_matches_between_teams filter on match['type'] (brazilian_soccer_mcp_server.py:433,493), but because of R2 only novo_campeonato (all typed 'Brasileirão') loads — Copa do Brasil and Libertadores rows are entirely dropped, so the filter spans only 1 of 3 competitions at runtime.
top_findings.suggestion: Fix R2 so Brazilian_Cup_Matches.csv and Libertadores_Matches.csv load.

top_findings.title: No tool to search players by name
top_findings.evidence: AST of brazilian_soccer_mcp_server.py: the only player tools are find_players_by_club (:627, club+nationality) and find_top_players (:668, nationality/club/min_overall). No function accepts a player-name argument; the only 'name' function is clean_team_name (:365). Moot at runtime anyway since players is empty (R2).
top_findings.suggestion: Add a find_player_by_name(name) tool that substring-matches soccer_data.players['name'].

top_findings.title: Player nationality/club filters implemented but return nothing (0 players loaded)
top_findings.evidence: find_players_by_club (:627) and find_top_players (:668) filter by club/nationality/overall, but load_player_data splits fifa_data.csv on '","' (:338, 1 part < 15 guard) so soccer_data.players is empty; both tools always return 'No players found'.
top_findings.suggestion: Fix the fifa_data.csv parser (R2) so player tools return data.

top_findings.title: No season-standings calculation from match results
top_findings.evidence: No function computes points/positions. 'points' never appears in brazilian_soccer_mcp_server.py; no standings/table/ranking function in the AST. get_team_statistics (:548) gives per-team W/L/D only; calculate_statistics (:714) totals matches/goals; find_biggest_victories (:767) lists margins. Nothing aggregates a per-season points table.
top_findings.suggestion: Add a tool that groups matches by season, computes 3*W+D points per team, and sorts into a standings table.
